# Equilux design system changelog (current: 0.3.1)

Newest first. To bring a project up to date, apply every entry newer than the version in its `.equilux-design-version`, oldest first, using each entry's Find hints.

- **0.3.1** (2026-10-08) — Errata: the §3.5 dark-theme contrast table listed `green-400` on `navy-700` as AA for normal text; it measures 4.36 : 1, which is AA for large text only. Added a stopgap rule for link and accent text on `surface` in dark theme (§3.5 errata, §9 Links). Also corrected `paper` @72% on `navy-700` (6.4 : 1) from "AA + AAA" to "AA (AAA for large text only)"; AAA for normal text needs 7 : 1, and AA remains the bar, so no usage changes. No token values changed.
  - **Update your project:** dark-theme links or accent-colored text smaller than 24px (18.66px bold) inside cards or panels on `surface` → set them in `text` with a permanent underline. Find: `var(--eqx-link)` or `var(--eqx-accent)` used as `color` inside elements whose background is `var(--eqx-surface)`; Tailwind `text-link` / `text-accent` inside `bg-surface`.
- **0.3.0** (2026-09-25) — Added a semantic token layer and dark theme (§3.5, §11): `bg`/`surface`/`text`/`text-secondary`/`border`/`link`/`accent`/`highlight` resolve to different literal palette tokens per theme (full navy/paper inversion, matching the logo's existing Primary/Reversed pair); `cta-*` stays theme-invariant. All new dark-mode color pairs contrast-verified against WCAG AA. §9 component rules rewritten against semantic tokens so they hold in both themes without separate dark variants.
- **0.2.0** (2026-09-05) — Logo/mark finalized (§8): "equilu" + custom gold X + rule-and-dot, primary and reversed versions. Stacked lockup, clear-space/min-size specs, and a one-color version remain open.
- **0.1.0** (2026-09-04) — Initial spec: color system, typography, spacing, graphic motif, component principles, voice/tone skeleton. Logo/mark and voice/tone content intentionally deferred to follow-up tasks.
